info.name: Hotel Offer Orchestrator
info.description:
End-to-end checks for the Hotel Offer Orchestrator API.

Run the folders in order (Collection Runner or `newman`). Folder 0 resets supplier availability and evicts cached cities, so the collection can be run repeatedly.

Set `baseUrl` if the API is not on http://localhost:3000.

item.description: Resets supplier availability and evicts every city used below so the collection is repeatable.

item.name: 8. Validation and errors
item.description: Invalid input is rejected with a consistent error body before any workflow runs.

exec: pm.test('explains the problem', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.equal("city: city is required"));
